description: Which ORDER BY position forms are accepted, with which order and error numbers, over GA: 2, 2 DESC with a second key, 0, 3 (out of range for a two-column select), -1, 1.5, '2', 1 + 1, a position over SELECT *, over an expression column, when aliases swap the names (id AS v, v AS id), with DISTINCT, with GROUP BY and a second position, over a UNION, with TOP, and a repeated position? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-13b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
